headline: Chip stocks suffer worst stretch in 16 months as AI fatigue grips the market

rec: Consider trimming SOXL (-43.24%), MUU (-22.32%), and SPAL (-27.87%) to reduce exposure to sector weakness and leveraged decay. Respect their current stops.
